cases.sentence: Вы едите жир, одеваетесь в шерсть и режете ___, но об отаре не заботитесь.
cases.explain: «отборных животных» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: You eat the fat. You clothe yourself with the wool. You kill the fatlings, but you don’t feed the sheep.

cases.sentence: И они рассеялись без пастуха, а рассеявшись, стали пищей для ___.
cases.explain: «диких зверей» — after the preposition «для», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: They were scattered, because there was no shepherd. They became food to all the animals of the field, and were scattered.

cases.sentence: Мои овцы скитались по горам и ___.
cases.explain: «высоким холмам» — the dative marks the indirect object or recipient.
cases.translation: My sheep wandered through all the mountains, and on every high hill. Yes, my sheep were scattered on all the surface of the earth. There was no one who searched or sought.”

cases.sentence: Я спасу Мою отару из их ___.
cases.explain: «голодных челюстей» — after the preposition «из», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.

cases.sentence: Я буду водить их на хорошие пастбища; ___ Израиля будут их выгоном.
cases.explain: «горные вершины» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: I will feed them with good pasture; and their fold will be on the mountains of the height of Israel. There they will lie down in a good fold. They will feed on fat pasture on the mountains of Israel.

cases.sentence: Они будут отдыхать там на ___, и пастись на богатых пастбищах в горах Израиля.
cases.explain: «хорошем выгоне» — after the preposition «на», for location or topic.
cases.translation: I will feed them with good pasture; and their fold will be on the mountains of the height of Israel. There they will lie down in a good fold. They will feed on fat pasture on the mountains of Israel.

cases.sentence: Они будут отдыхать там на хорошем выгоне, и пастись на ___ в горах Израиля.
cases.explain: «богатых пастбищах» — after the preposition «на», for location or topic.
cases.translation: I will feed them with good pasture; and their fold will be on the mountains of the height of Israel. There they will lie down in a good fold. They will feed on fat pasture on the mountains of Israel.

cases.explain: «хорошем пастбище» — after the preposition «на», for location or topic.
cases.translation: Does it seem a small thing to you to have fed on the good pasture, but you must tread down with your feet the residue of your pasture? And to have drunk of the clear waters, but must you foul the residue with your feet?

cases.sentence: Я заключу с ним завет мира и прогоню из этой земли диких зверей, чтобы овцы могли безопасно жить в ___ и спать в лесу.
cases.explain: «диких местах» — after the preposition «в», for location or topic.
cases.translation: “ ‘I will make with them a covenant of peace, and will cause evil animals to cease out of the land. They will dwell securely in the wilderness, and sleep in the woods.

cases.sentence: Народы не будут впредь грабить их, а ___ не будут их пожирать.
cases.explain: «дикие звери» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: They will no more be a prey to the nations, neither will the animals of the earth devour them; but they will dwell securely, and no one will make them afraid.
